hero.title: Privacy Policy
hero.description: Information on the processing of personal data in accordance with the GDPR (EU) 2016/679 and Spanish LOPDGDD 3/2018.

controller.title: 1. Data controller
controller.address: Address: Pº Rosa de los Vientos, nº 39 - Esc. 2, 3º, Pta. 5, 46730 Gandía, Valencia (Spain)

data.title: 2. Data processed
data.p1: The personal data we process is that voluntarily provided by the user through the contact forms on this website or via email: name, email address and the content of the message.
data.p2: We do not process specially protected data, nor do we carry out automated evaluations or profiling.

purpose.title: 3. Purpose of processing
purpose.p1: The data provided through the contact forms is used exclusively to manage and respond to enquiries, information requests, collaboration proposals and participation in the association's projects or programmes.

lawfulness.title: 4. Lawful basis
lawfulness.p1: The lawful basis for processing is the data subject's express consent, given by checking the box accepting this privacy policy when submitting the form (Art. 6.1.a GDPR).

recipients.title: 5. Recipients
recipients.p1: No data is transferred or communicated to third parties, except where required by law. No international data transfers are made.

retention.title: 6. Retention periods
retention.p1: Data will be retained for the time strictly necessary to fulfil the purpose for which it was collected and, in any case, for the legally applicable period. It will then be deleted.

rights.title: 7. Rights of data subjects
rights.p1: Any person has the right to obtain confirmation as to whether Colores del Mundo is processing personal data concerning them or not.
rights.p2: Likewise, they have the right to access their data, rectify it, delete it, object to its processing, request its limitation or, where appropriate, request the portability of their data. To exercise these rights, they must send an email to somoscoloresdelmundo@gmail.com, enclosing a copy of an identification document.
rights.p3: Likewise, and especially if you consider that you have not obtained full satisfaction in the exercise of your rights, you may file a claim with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (AEPD), through its electronic headquarters (www.aepd.es) or at its offices (C/ Jorge Juan, 6, 28001 Madrid).

hero.title: Cookies Policy
hero.description: Information on the use of cookies on coloresdelmundo.org.

what.title: 1. What are cookies?
what.p1: Cookies are small text files that a website sends to the user's browser and are stored on their device. They allow the website to remember information about the visit, facilitating navigation and enabling usage analysis.

types.title: 2. Types of cookies we use
types.p1: This website, given its informative and institutional nature, only uses technical cookies strictly necessary for the correct functioning of the site (for example, to remember the selected language or the light/dark mode preference).
types.p2: These cookies do not require consent, in accordance with the exception of art. 22.2 of the LSSI, and are not used to collect information about users or for advertising.

thirdParty.title: 3. Third-party cookies
thirdParty.p1: This website may contain links to external sites (social networks, Google Maps). The use of cookies on such external sites is governed by the privacy policies of each platform, and Colores del Mundo is not responsible for them.

management.title: 4. Cookie management
management.p1: The user can manage and, where appropriate, block or delete cookies through their browser configuration options. If technical cookies are blocked, some functionalities of the site may be affected.

more.title: 5. More information
more.p1: For any questions about the use of cookies, you can contact us at somoscoloresdelmundo@gmail.com.
